name: interactioncombinators
description: Lafont's interaction combinators on a Void Maiz canvas: every gesture and every rewrite is a dispatched, logged, undoable Void Core command, and two people can reduce one net at once.

requires.name: voidmaiz
requires.note: the canvas, gestures, inspector, the reduce executor, the collaboration layer, the phone layout kit and the update client. Void Maiz in turn locates Void Core (../VoidCore) and Void Allomone (../VoidAllomone).

requires.name: voidpalabra
requires.note: sync. Present: the desktop build gains Host/Join and the two-window duo bench. Absent: the app builds solo.

platforms_note: A SHIPPING RECORD, as Void Maiz and Void Hormiga use the field: both were built and handed to a person (0.2.0, 2026-09-21; the author ran the APK on a phone). The Windows build is a portable .zip and the Android build an .apk, not the setup.exe / .tar.gz that `mago feed` names today, so tools/package_release.ps1 fills in the artifact names and hashes after Mago writes the document (asked of Void Mago 2026-09-21).

release.summary: wires that vanished between devices are fixed, the phone has a keyboard and press-and-hold to make a node, and live physics is now shared by the net
adds: Press and hold on empty canvas (on a phone) to make a node right there
A keyboard on the phone, so tags, net names and file names can finally be typed
Suggested tags: what other agents of the same kind carry, one tap to add (from Void Hormiga)
The LAN panel says when you are on a phone's hotspot, and suggests one when there is no Wi-Fi
A Linux build, for testing three devices at once (tools/build_linux.sh)

behavior_changes.what: Live physics is now a setting of the NET, not of your device: turning it on turns it on for everyone, and one device runs the simulation while the others receive the positions it settles on
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone using live physics with other devices joined

behavior_changes.what: New agents are named with a short per-device tag (gamma-a3f-1), so two devices never mint the same name
On a phone, pressing and holding empty canvas opens the add palette instead of the context menu; holding a node or a wire still opens the menu

fixes: Wires made by dragging a port out and creating a node there now reach the other device. Both devices were naming the new node the same thing, and a wire that names its ends could not tell them apart, so it vanished on the other screen
